page.overview:
What is The Infinity Saga?

The Infinity Saga is a licensed sub-theme of Marvel Studios that was introduced in 2021. The theme aims to remake various locations and vehicles from the first 11 years of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, including films that hadn't had LEGO sets before (e.g. 2008's Iron Man), or represent films that had been previously underrepresented in their initial tie-in waves (e.g 2019's Avenger's Endgame and 2017's Thor Ragnarok).
